ideas.pitch: An indoor AR and IoT-based real-time navigation system built for complex multi-building college campuses, leveraging IEEE ComSoc network optimization principles to route users seamlessly across disconnected Wi-Fi and Bluetooth mesh zones.
ideas.title: Multiverse Campus Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organized in collaboration with IEEE ComSoc and IEEE APS, this project directly targets telecommunications and antenna propagation themes valued by the organizing societies.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered RF spectrum anomaly detector that analyzes wireless interference patterns in real-time, helping IEEE APS researchers identify unauthorized or faulty signal transmissions.
ideas.title: SpectrumGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the IEEE Antennas and Propagation Society (APS) judges by solving a core wireless engineering problem with modern machine learning.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent peer and professional networking platform tailored for IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE), utilizing vector embeddings to pair aspiring female technologists with industry mentors based on niche skill overlaps.
ideas.title: WIE Mentor Match
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core mission and evaluation criteria of the co-organizing IEEE WIE chapter, ensuring strong emotional resonance and relevance with the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized offline messaging progressive web app designed for disaster response, utilizing device-to-device Bluetooth Low Energy mesh networking when cellular infrastructure fails.
ideas.title: NodeMesh Emergency Comms
ideas.why_it_could_win: Scores high on technical implementation and social impact, addressing a severe real-world infrastructure failure scenario relevant to IEEE ComSoc.

ideas.pitch: An ideation brainstorming tool built specifically for hackathons that ingests disparate problem statements and uses multi-agent LLM loops to generate cross-disciplinary, unconventional startup solutions.
ideas.title: Multiverse Idea Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the paradox multiverse theme head-on while giving student organizers and participants a tool they can immediately use and appreciate in the room.
